steps.label: 2345-own-item2089216-product-modal-open
command: (async()=>{if(new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('itemId')!=='2089216'||document.querySelector('.modal.show'))throw Error('Own single item only');const modal=document.getElementById('itemProductModal'),button=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-bs-target]')].find(e=>e.dataset.bsTarget==='#itemProductModal');if(!modal||!button||button.matches(':disabled'))throw Error('Observed product relation action required');const shown=new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const timer=setTimeout(()=>reject(Error('Product modal shown timeout')),5000);modal.addEventListener('shown.bs.modal',()=>{clearTimeout(timer);resolve();},{once:true});});button.click();await shown;return {modal:modal.id,text:modal.innerText,fields:[...modal.querySelectorAll('input,select')].map(e=>({name:e.name,value:e.value,disabled:e.matches(':disabled')}))};})()
